newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan to sentence stabber of Israeli next month.
newsitem.headline: Jordan to sentence stabber of Israeli next month.

text.p: A Jordanian criminal court trying a student who stabbed an Israeli tourist will announce its verdict in early August after examining evidence and hearing his testimony, a defence lawyer said on Sunday.
Hamza Gharaibah, 22, a second-year student at Yarmouk University, was arrested after stabbing and lightly wounding an Israeli woman in a northern beauty spot in April.
He was later charged with attempt to kill and possession of a sharp knife and put on trial.

His defence lawyer Assad Gharaibah, a distant relative, said he expected a light prison term for his client at the final court session on August 7 as it was evident he had not meant to cause serious injury.
The woman tourist has since dropped her case against him.

Gharaibah told Reuters his client pleaded not guilty, saying he had acted impulsively after the woman took pictures of him without his consent. He said the student was enraged when she refused to hand over her film.

Defence sources say the police tried to prove Gharaibah's attack was a politically motivated revenge for the jailing of his cousin Akrimah Gharaibah, serving a life sentence for plotting attacks on Israeli tourists.

A state security court sentenced Akrimah Gharaibah earlier in the year to a death sentence, which was reduced to life on charges of making explosives and attempting to blow up an Israeli tourist bus in Jordan.
Hamza Gharaibah said he was not aware the tourist he attacked was an Israeli until police interrogated him and asked why he attacked a Jewish woman, defence sources said.
"He is not politicised and there were no political motives. It was a brawl between two people," his lawyer said.
Earlier this month a Jordanian military tribunal passed a life sentence on a Jordanian soldier who was convicted of killing seven Israeli schoolgirls at a border post in March.
The tribunal rejected defence arguments that the soldier was provoked by schoolgirls teasing him and taking pictures while he prayed.
